title: On-the-fly Weight Generation: A Hypernetwork Proof of Concept on ARC-1D
abstract: arXiv:2610.00820v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: General-purpose models can adapt to many tasks from context, while specialised models can execute individual functions with less capacity. Yet obtaining such specialists requires task-specific training or adaptation. We ask whether they can instead be generated directly from a few demonstrations. Using ARC-1D as a controlled testbed, we show that individual transformations can be represented by tiny specialist models, and that a hypernetwork can generate their parameters from context. The generated parameters form a structured weight space, while the resulting specialists show partial compositional generalisation and generalisation to transformations not seen during training. In both settings, removing explicit task identifiers improves generalisation beyond the training transformations. Together, these results provide a proof of concept that few-shot task context can be compiled on-the-fly into compact executable model parameters, and

translated_title: 即时权重生成：基于ARC-1D的超网络概念验证
translated_abstract: 通用模型可以通过上下文适应多种任务，而专用模型能够以更小的容量执行特定功能。然而，获得这类专用模型需要针对特定任务的训练或适配。我们探究是否可以直接从少量示例中生成这些专用模型。以ARC-1D作为受控测试平台，我们展示了单个变换可以由微型专用模型表示，并且超网络可以从上下文生成这些模型的参数。生成的参数构成了一个结构化的权重空间，由此产生的专用模型表现出部分组合泛化能力，以及对训练中未见过的变换的泛化能力。在两种设置中，移除显式任务标识符都能提高超出训练变换范围的泛化能力。总之，这些结果提供了一个概念验证，证明少样本任务上下文可以被即时编译为紧凑的可执行模型参数。
tldr: 该论文提出利用超网络从少量示例上下文中即时生成微型专用模型的权重参数，并以ARC-1D验证了这种“即时权重生成”方法可以形成结构化权重空间，实现组合泛化及对未见变换的泛化，且移除显式任务标识符能进一步提升泛化能力。
